name: terminal-split-view
title: Terminal Split View
description: Side-by-side dual console panes for monitoring concurrent build logs and server output.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Dual Terminal Monitoring: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
